diagnostic_pca: Two separate 2-D PCA fits, only each frozen model training rows; svd_solver=full. Never used by classifier. No other estimator fit.
ovo: Stored classifier._decision_function on frozen transformed data; verified against copied classifier with public decision_function_shape=ovo. Positive pair score favors earlier classes_ entry; zero treated as later for libsvm votes. OvR reconstruction separately uses dec<0 as installed sklearn.
boundary: For three focus pairs raw margin divided by exact RBF RKHS weight norm. This is signed distance to binary hyperplane in RKHS, not input-space distance, probability, calibrated confidence or nearest multiclass boundary. Compare empirical Train abs-distance quartile; no operational threshold.
neighbors: Exact Euclidean, all 128 frozen preprocessed features. k=1,5; stable Train-row-order ties. Native A/B spaces plus A-space range control.
sensor_mapping: UCI224 confirms 16 consecutive 8-feature blocks: delta_R, normalized_R, EMA rise .001/.01/.1, EMA decay .001/.01/.1. Sensor index is feature block; physical hardware serial mapping unavailable.
sensor_selection: Post-hoc diagnostic only. Rank 16 sensors by mean of eight Wasserstein distances: Batch9 Toluene vs Train1-7 Toluene, divided by same-gas Train population SD; choose top two, sensor id tie break. All sensors and 128 features retained in original classifiers.
sensor_space: Common frozen A scaler for comparable means/correlations/PCA support plots. Conditional Wasserstein normalization per reference gas SD.
clustering: Batch9 Toluene only, frozen A standardized 128-D; Ward hierarchical descriptive partitions k=2,3,4, no prediction model fit. No choice of best k; k2 main display, others sensitivity, not sessions.
interpretation: Retrospective diagnostic, not causal attribution or model selection.
